title: 第一章：今天开始营业 · 第4节：黄昏：一盏灯的来客
description: 莉瑟的提灯与晶石产生共鸣。三人约定结伴调查矿道入口，遇险即撤，不深入未知区域。
source: 原创奇幻剧情与四道分段听力题，非考试原文。
audioLabel: 离线固定角色英文配音

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Lyse pauses by the door, looking first at the menu and then at the faintly glowing counter.
lines.translation: 莉瑟在门边停下，先看了墙上的菜单，再看向亮着微光的吧台。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: Is the seat you mentioned still free? I would like some hot soup, and a look at that crystal.
lines.translation: 你说的座位还空着吗？我想喝碗热汤，也想看看那块晶石。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: We have seats and soup. The crystal is not a free gift, though. You can look from this side of the counter.
lines.translation: 座位有，汤也有。晶石不能当赠品，只能隔着吧台看。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: Do not worry, I will not take it. My lantern is calmer here than it was in the market.
lines.translation: 放心，我不拿走它。我的灯靠近这里时，比在集市安静。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: I am Aelia. Lu Chuan said you warned him not to enter the mine alone. Thank you.
lines.translation: 我叫艾莉娅。陆川说你提醒他别独自去矿道，谢谢。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: Lyse. Today I am here for a seat, and to check something.
lines.translation: 莉瑟。今天我只是来借个座位，顺便确认一件事。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: A pale violet butterfly rises from the lantern and settles beside the crystal's crack, gently folding its wings.
lines.translation: 一只淡紫光蝶从灯罩边升起，落在晶石裂缝旁，翅膀轻轻合拢。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: It stopped beside the missing piece. Does your lantern recognize this crystal?
lines.translation: 它停在缺口边上了。你的灯认识这块晶石？

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: It follows related magic, but cannot tell me an object's name. To the north, it sensed another echo.
lines.translation: 它追踪相近的魔力，不能告诉我东西的名字。在北边，它感觉到了另一道回声。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: The crest on the handle... I have seen it on the royal escort's banner.
lines.translation: 灯柄上的纹章……我曾在王室护送队的旗帜上见过。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: Please keep that to yourself for now. I do not want everyone to hear only my title and ignore what I say.
lines.translation: 请先替我保密。我不想让每个人都只听见那个身份，而不听我说什么。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: You came to help us examine the crystal. A bowl of our practice soup does not require you to share your secrets.
lines.translation: 你是来帮忙确认晶石的，不必用自己的秘密交换一碗试菜的汤。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: For the last three nights, lamps in northern town have gone out suddenly. Before each blackout, my lantern pointed toward the old mine.
lines.translation: 近三晚，镇北的灯会突然熄灭。熄灭前，我的提灯都指向旧矿道。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: The guards reported unfamiliar tracks today too. The clues may be related, but do not prove the cause.
lines.translation: 守卫今天也报告了陌生脚印。两个线索有关，但还不能证明原因。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: If there is a fragment in the mine, can the lantern find it?
lines.translation: 如果矿道里有碎片，灯能找到它吗？

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: It can point the way, but cannot guarantee a safe path. I am not confident about going in alone.
lines.translation: 只能指方向，无法保证道路安全。我自己没有把握进去。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Then we go together, only as far as the entrance and first junction. If we find danger, we retreat instead of pursuing it deeper.
lines.translation: 那就结伴，只看入口和第一处岔路。发现危险就撤，不追进深处。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: I will read the markings and record our route. You take the front, while Lyse lights the way and follows the echo.
lines.translation: 我负责读标记和记录路线。你挡在前面，莉瑟负责照明和寻找回声。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Aelia checks the water flask and her shield strap. Lu Chuan leaves the sign at not yet open and writes down their expected return time.
lines.translation: 艾莉娅检查水袋和盾带。陆川把门牌留在尚未营业的一面，并写下预计返回的时间。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: I will tell the gate watch our route. If we are late, they will know where to look.
lines.translation: 我会让镇门值守的人知道我们的路线。如果迟迟不回，他们至少知道去哪里找。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: We will check the crystal clue before returning to open. Our reserve and supplies are ready.
lines.translation: 先把晶石的线索查清，再回来开门。备用金和食材都留好了。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Write down our return path too. Coming back matters more than going far.
lines.translation: 我们把退路也写清楚。能回来，比走得远更重要。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: Thank you. Knowing that someone will hear me out is more reassuring than having my crest recognized.
lines.translation: 谢谢。有人愿意先听完我的话，比认出纹章更让我安心。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: The three cross the stone bridge toward the north. The lantern lights their footing without urging anyone to hurry.
lines.translation: 三人沿石桥走向镇北。提灯照着脚下的路，没有催促任何人加快脚步。

questions.prompt: Why does Lyse visit the waystation?
options: To have soup and examine the crystal.
questions.explanation: 莉瑟说她想喝热汤，也想查看晶石。

questions.prompt: How does Lu Chuan respond to Lyse's request for privacy?
options: He respects her choice to keep her identity private.
He demands her title before serving soup.
He announces the crest to every guest.
He refuses to let her stay.
questions.explanation: 陆川尊重莉瑟暂时保密的请求，不要求用秘密换取招待。

questions.prompt: What do the three agree to do?
options: Follow the lantern anywhere without stopping.
Send Lyse into the mine alone.
Wait until the crystal repairs itself.
Inspect the entrance and first junction, retreating if danger appears.
questions.explanation: 提灯只指方向，不能保证安全；约定只看入口和第一处岔路，遇险撤离。

questions.prompt: Why will Lyse tell the gate watch their route?
options: So the watch knows where to look if they return late.
To keep Aelia out of town.
So no one can follow them.
questions.explanation: 告知路线让值守人员在三人未按时返回时有明确搜寻方向。

ending: 莉瑟的提灯与晶石产生共鸣。三人约定结伴调查矿道入口，遇险即撤，不深入未知区域。
